Actually it isn't bakelite, it's actually AG-S4 which is a resin made of twisted glass fibers permeated with phenol-formaldehyde binder. Some of the rifle furniture is authentic bakelite but most of it was AG-S4 for the "red" magazines and later ABS plastic (like the kind in legos) that are the characteristic "plum" color @Trolling_Thunder mentioned.

Bakelite has a retarded long manufacturing process, but as you might have already guessed, AG-S4 is quite simple and straightforward.
